author: North Charlotte Today
title: How to follow Carolina Panthers vs. Pittsburgh Steelers in preseason finale
text:
Bank of America Stadium | Carolina Panthers
Bank of America Stadium | Carolina Panthers
Carolina will play its final preseason game of 2025 against the Pittsburgh Steelers on Thursday, August 21 at 7:00 p.m. ET. The matchup will take place at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte.
Fans can watch the game on television through the Panthers Television Network. Anish Shroff will handle play-by-play duties, with Jake Delhomme and Steve Smith Sr. as analysts, and Carla Metts reporting from the sideline.
The broadcast is also available via live stream for fans located within the Panthers’ primary markets through Panthers.com and the official team app. Those outside these areas can use NFL Game Pass, which is offering a free seven-day trial to watch preseason games live.
A Spanish-language broadcast will be provided by Telemundo, featuring Carlos Ramirez on play-by-play and Ariana Figuera as analyst.
For those preferring radio coverage, local broadcasts are available on 99.7 FM The Fox in Charlotte and other affiliate stations throughout the region. Jim Szoke will provide play-by-play commentary alongside analysts Kurt Coleman and Kevin Donnalley, with Kristen Balboni reporting from the sideline. Coverage begins at 4:00 p.m. ET and includes an hour of post-game analysis.
Live updates, highlights, and additional coverage can be accessed through the Panthers’ mobile app as well as their social media channels on Twitter, Facebook, and Instagram.
